Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, October 8 · NFL Week 5 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 6, 10:44 AM ET

Dak Prescott has the highest SPAGS projection in the Buccaneers at Cowboys DraftKings Showdown: 19.7 points at $10,400 FLEX, 29.6 at captain for $15,600. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Prescott is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.8 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary, in a game with a 47.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 14.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Prescott at captain. Jalon Daniels is the next captain in line, at 14.2%. The model has him running 6.5 times.

Dallas is a 9.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 28.5 for the Cowboys and 19 for the Buccaneers.

Behind Prescott and Daniels, the next projections are CeeDee Lamb (18.6, $11,800), Javonte Williams (17.9, $10,800) and George Pickens (15.0, $9,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 6, 10:44 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Dak Prescott, DAL QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Dak Prescott holds 14.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 19.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Prescott averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 36.4. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.9% as the captain and 57.5% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jalon Daniels, TB QB ($8,600 FLEX / $12,900 CPT)

Jalon Daniels holds 14.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $12,900 and the 18.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.5 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 33.6. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.2% as the captain and 51.6% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: CeeDee Lamb, DAL WR ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

CeeDee Lamb holds 12.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 18.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 8.4 targets on 31.6 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 18.8 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 38.4. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.1% as the captain and 40.9% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Flournoy averaged 9.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.2 and a ceiling of 21.9. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.2% as the captain and 37.0% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Hurst averaged 6.2 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 18.0. Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown?

Dak Prescott holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 14.9%, ahead of Jalon Daniels (14.2%) and CeeDee Lamb (12.1%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Buccaneers vs Cowboys?

Build around Jalon Daniels at captain with Dak Prescott, Javonte Williams and Bucky Irving at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (30 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $7,500 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown?

Dak Prescott leads the SPAGS model at 19.7 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 29.6 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Buccaneers vs Cowboys Showdown?

CeeDee Lamb is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 27 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Buccaneers vs Cowboys DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Ryan Flournoy (9.4 points at $3,800), Ted Hurst III (6.2 points at $2,800) and Cade Otton (8.7 points at $4,400).

What is the Buccaneers vs Cowboys spread and total?

The Cowboys are a 9.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 47.5, with implied team totals of 28.5 for the Cowboys and 19 for the Buccaneers.
